roots.source_assembly_root: Future fresh exclusive isolated source root outside every protected/project root, not created
roots.runtime_root: Future authenticated immutable Python/stdlib/wheel/DLL image; never ambient host library tree
roots.git_identity_root: Existing independent Stage A clone, readonly; never a source-only cwd

interfaces: VerifyGitIdentity(git_identity_root, trusted_git, fresh_nonce) -> four actual bounded child proofs
ReadFrozenSourceInventory(identity_session, fixed_commit) -> fifth actual bounded Git child proof
SealBinding(identity_proofs, inventory, source_manifest_digest, runtime_image_digest, policy_digest, session_nonce, expiry) -> immutable authenticated capsule
OpenBoundSource(capsule, module, source_assembly_root_handle) -> final file handle + exact immutable byte buffer + file identity
ExecuteApprovedImport(capsule, source_buffer, approved_loader) -> LOADING/EXECUTED evidence; NOT_AUTHORIZED_THIS_TASK
VerifyNineAndSeal(capsule, actual_modules, retained_handles, end_readback) -> evidence only; requires independent acceptance
binding_fields: five fresh Git proofs: executable hash,argv,cwd,nonce,PID,exit,audit,Job,reap,joined streams and hashes
raw blob SHA1 header,bytes,SHA256 for every admitted source
all three original nonempty init and their import order
source root volume/fileID and retained root handles; canonical paths private only
runtime image+stdlib/wheels/PYD/DLL hashes and configuration digest
no-pycache policy and verified source write denial
allowed definition-time code generation and call graph policy digest
session nonce/expiry/one-use issuer signature or authenticated readonly transfer
start and end fileID/raw hash readbacks; loaded order vs predicted order and all nine actual bindings

rules.requirement: Keep four exact Git identity requests plus fifth fixed-commit inventory against readonly Stage A Git root; never point Git cwd at assembly tree; all outputs must bind to actual fresh children, not reused historic receipts.
Do not share objects/common-dir, copy a worktree, rewrite init or relax fixed commit/path/blob identities. Assembly reads may resolve only a reviewed set through one-use authenticated capsule.

Reject absolute/drive/UNC/device/ADS/traversal/reserved paths, case-fold collisions,8.3 aliases,symlinks,reparse mounts and hardlink aliases in assembly; unique canonical module mapping and parent hierarchy.

Canonical text checks alone do not defeat TOCTOU. Trusted broker opens and retains root/ancestor handles with restrictive sharing, denies untrusted directory mutation via OS policy, checks final volume/fileID/reparse status; implementation feasibility UNKNOWN until separately reviewed.

Read final authenticated handle once; hash exact bytes and compile same immutable buffer, no reopen-by-path for execution. Verify length and UTF8 without newline normalization; root/path IDs and byte hashes again at end.
Pin no-source-write/no-pycache with runtime flags plus loader behavior plus OS denial. Readonly file attribute alone is insufficient, especially for same user/admin or writable parent.

Fresh process denies preloaded model prefix; finder owned and bound, exact __file__/__path__/spec.origin,sys.modules object identity,loader+module spec loader,raw hashes; all nine must actually reach EXECUTED. Never import missing nine solely to satisfy check without semantic approval.

Record LOADING before exec, transition EXECUTED only after successful return; any exception leaves terminal failure. Current finder.loaded pre-exec insertion cannot be treated as successful load. Allow only normal expected sys.modules insertions; unexpected replacement/mutation fails closed.

Capsule/session cannot be replayed across roots/runtime/policy; no self-attested boolean trusted_runtime_io. Trusted issuer and transfer authenticity require independent design review. Preserve real Git child nonce/audit/Job identity if sandbox moves execution across process/guest boundary.

root_binding_contract.transition_rule: Every state requires prior gate evidence AND fresh future Owner authority. Any unavailable/changed identity,failed deny,quota,timeout or unexpected import -> terminal FAIL_CLOSED; UNKNOWN cannot advance. No runtime state reached this task.
failure_receipt_fields: bounded failure code and permitted relative object identity

gates.name: Reproducible trusted runtime identity
gates.evidence: Exact Python executable/architecture/version/build + stdlib/DLL/PYD/wheel file hashes; trusted distribution origin and offline artifacts/lock with dependency hashes. Minimum project versions alone insufficient; setuptools build-only unless explicit runtime need.

gates.name: Startup/path provenance
gates.evidence: Fresh isolated no-site/no-user-site/no-bytecode launch; explicit allowlisted sys.path only pinned runtime and bound source; inspect applicable ._pth,pyvenv.cfg,.pth,sitecustomize/usercustomize,environment,PYTHONPATH/PYTHONHOME and DLL search config statically first. -I -S does not establish OS isolation or enumerate every native hook.

gates.name: Native dependency closure
gates.evidence: Inventory wheels,RECORD and separately verified release hashes,extension .pyd,BLAS/LAPACK/OpenMP/runtime DLLs,PE and delay-load/system dependencies; no ad-hoc DLL lookup in cwd/PATH or arbitrary LoadLibrary. Exact trusted Windows base image/config; hashes alone not safety proof. Native dynamic targets remain unknown until constrained.

gates.name: OS/native isolation
gates.evidence: Preferred future design target disposable Windows VM with no host mounts/drives/clipboard/credentials/network device and only authenticated readonly input medium plus tightly bounded output channel. Host sees no model import. Restricted token/AppContainer/ACL/firewall/WDAC alternatives require separately proved effective read/write/network/DLL/process restrictions; Job/audit/profile alone insufficient.

gates.name: External I/O and startup behavior
gates.evidence: OS policy denies real/protected host data,unapproved file/registry/environment changes,network,process spawning and native libraries outside image. Any required library cache/config/temp access must be explicit finite guest-local policy, not blanket user/drive allowlist; import failure does not justify broadening or fallbacks. Diagnostic logs do not replace enforcement.

gates.name: Evidence and least privilege
gates.evidence: Future OS identity/policy receipts and adversarial non-model fixtures proving denied file/native network/DLL/process actions before third-party startup, then separately authorized dependency-only load. Enforce elapsed/RSS/output quotas; prove termination and no protected mount. Nothing installed or tested here.
